VAHU.craft_notes: A livelier, more ownable look (steaming-cup sun, striped waves, coral CTA pill, amber highlight words) that adapts well per shape, but execution is loose: CTA collides with waves on the story, stars hit letters, dangling separators, muddy halos and a clipped wave block on the leaderboard.
VAHU.revision_notes: Headline and menu item changed in all six; colour emphasis sensibly remapped to 'Winter Menu:'. Collateral: on x-post/facebook the longer menu line now wraps to two lines, pushing date and CTA down; on the square 'Winter Menu:' now runs almost into the sun rings; story menu line rewrapped with a stray star before 'Gingerbread' and a dangling dot. Motif and waves otherwise unchanged.

WGJQ.craft_notes: Clean, consistent and publishable system: serif headline, light sans body, eyebrow, coral rule, moonlit sun and layered hills used at every size with good margins. Somewhat generic motif (plain disc + hills) and a few soft line breaks on the story, but nothing broken.
WGJQ.revision_notes: Both copy changes made in all six; layouts otherwise held. Collateral: on instagram-square the sun moved up and right (about 40 px) to clear the longer headline; story menu line re-wrapped ('Spiced honey / cortado'). Other sizes changed only in the text areas.

pairwise_round1.why: WGJQ is clean at every size, while VAHU's more characterful set has visible execution faults (CTA colliding with the waves on the story, stars on letters, clipped wave block on the leaderboard).
